Title: Serra Coat
Body (HTML): Double-faced wool and cashmere, woven in Biella and cut without a lining so the coat falls from the shoulder. Raglan sleeves and a waist without darts let the volume settle around the body in movement. Wrap closure with a belt in the same cloth.

Title: Doppio Trench
Body (HTML): Egyptian cotton gabardine with a dry-wax finish. Two layers across the back and a high centre vent for walking. The belt fastens with a covered buckle, with no metal in sight.

Title: Cocoon Cardigan-Coat
Body (HTML): Alpaca spun in Arequipa, knitted in an open stitch and made without side seams. Wear it as a light coat indoors or as a middle layer under a cloth coat.

Title: Quilted Silk Liner
Body (HTML): Washed silk filled with recycled down, quilted in four-centimetre channels. Designed to button inside the Serra Coat or to be worn on its own over fine knitwear.

Title: Nove Blazer
Body (HTML): The cut that gives the house its name. Mid-weight virgin wool, a natural shoulder without padding, one button and a high lapel. A floating canvas, hand-stitched at the chest, lets the jacket take the shape of the person who wears it.

Title: Cropped Tailored Jacket
Body (HTML): A short version of the Nove Blazer, finished at the natural waist. Two buttons, jetted pockets without flaps and a single back vent.

Title: Pleated Wide Trouser
Body (HTML): Two inverted pleats from a high waistband. Cool wool with four percent elastane in the weft, so the pleat holds through a day of sitting. Left unhemmed, ready to be finished to the shoe.

Title: Cigarette Trouser
Body (HTML): A straight, narrow leg, a high waistband and a concealed side zip. No front pockets, so the line of the hip stays clean.

Title: Wool Waistcoat
Body (HTML): A five-button waistcoat in the same cloth as the Nove Blazer, with a cupro back and an adjustable buckle. Designed to complete the suit or to be worn over a poplin shirt.

Title: Cashmere Rib Crew
Body (HTML): Two-ply cashmere in a fine rib, with a crew neck and double cuffs. Knitted at a family factory in Umbria that has worked with the house since the first collection.

Title: Fine Merino Turtleneck
Body (HTML): Extra-fine 19-micron merino with a high neck that folds over once. Thin enough to wear under tailoring without bulk at the shoulder.

Title: Hand-Framed Cotton Polo
Body (HTML): Long-staple cotton knitted on a hand-operated machine, with three corozo buttons and a flat collar. The knit relaxes with wear and recovers with washing.

Title: Oversized Alpaca Knit
Body (HTML): Alpaca in a chunky knit with a dropped shoulder and a short body. Made in two sizes, one and two. Designed to be worn over a long shirt.

Title: Poplin Column Shirt
Body (HTML): 120-thread cotton poplin, a straight body without darts and a length that falls below the hip. Semi-Italian collar with a soft interlining and a concealed placket.

Title: Silk Charmeuse Blouse
Body (HTML): Silk charmeuse with a heavy drape, a shirt collar and covered buttons. Cut one size generous on purpose so the fabric can move.

Title: Striped Cotton Shirt
Body (HTML): A woven stripe, not a print, in combed cotton. Single-button cuff and a centre pleat at the back.

Title: Bias-Cut Slip Dress
Body (HTML): Silk cut on the bias in four panels, with adjustable straps and a low back. The bias lets the dress follow the body without shaping seams.

Title: Column Knit Dress
Body (HTML): Merino knitted as a tube, without side seams, with a back vent at mid-calf. It steams flat and travels well.

Title: Wrap Wool Skirt
Body (HTML): A wool wrap skirt with a single visible seam and an inner tie. The wrap falls straight and does not open when walking.

Title: Pleated Midi Skirt
Body (HTML): Knife pleats heat-set in lightweight wool, a narrow waistband and a side closure. Mid-calf length.

Title: Leather Belt
Body (HTML): Single-layer vegetable-tanned leather, without reinforcement, with an unpolished brass buckle. It takes on colour with use.

Title: Cashmere Scarf
Body (HTML): Cashmere in a diagonal twill, 180 by 45 centimetres, with a hand-knotted fringe.

Title: Structured Tote
Body (HTML): Calf leather with a rigid base and handles hand-sewn in saddle stitch. One compartment, one inside pocket, no closure. Fits a thirteen-inch laptop.

Title: Silk Twill Square
Body (HTML): A 90-centimetre silk twill square with a hand-rolled hem. The design comes from the house's archive studio.
